action: Open the app and sign in.
voice_text: This is the first version of the Aadi Project Tracker mobile app, built with Expo and React Native. It uses the same server and the same permissions as the web app. The demo accounts are listed under the sign in button here too. We sign in as Meera Nair.
visual_instruction: Open the app and sign in.

voice_text: My tasks shows only the work assigned to her, with project, sprint, priority and due date. One tap changes the status. She starts the invoice register task, and the change is saved on the server.

On the timesheet tab she sees the week against the forty hour target. She adds one hour on the Project Tracker product, and submits the week for approval. The same rules apply as on the web: only assigned projects, no future dates, no more than twenty four hours a day.

action: Sign in as Isha Kapoor and acknowledge.
voice_text: Now Isha Kapoor, who has a handover waiting. The handover tab shows who is handing over, the project, the note and the tasks. Only the receiver sees the acknowledge button. One tap, and the project manager is notified.
visual_instruction: Sign in as Isha Kapoor and acknowledge.

voice_text: The alerts tab lists her notifications, such as new handovers and rejected time, and marks them as read. That completes the first mobile version: tasks, timesheet, handover and alerts. Push notifications and offline use are planned for later sprints.
